name: LIMBIC
source:
Two college students trying to survive midterms, late-night convenience store runs, and the occasional existential crisis. Oh, and they’re also magical boys tasked with fighting multi-dimensional horrors that creep into their world through the cracks of reality

[From [url=https://citrusplanes.itch.io/limbic]itch.io[/url]]

两名大学生试图在期中考试、深夜便利店经营和偶尔的生存危机中生存。哦，他们也是神奇的男孩，他们的任务是与通过现实裂缝潜入他们世界的多维恐怖分子作斗争
